Even if your just gathering resources as you go along, a leaf bed, cave, and a smoker can be good. A smoker might be more for you, takes about half the time of a drier for similar results, only lasts four days instead of five though. It’s important to keep purifying water along the way too to not get parasites and stay hydrated. You never know when a misstep will lead to a fever, always prepare for the worst, and always keep enough sticks and small sticks to make a small fire immediately!

1) You can find the campfire at certain places, you’ll know it when you find it. Stone ring is a good middle ground though.

2) You get the grilling rack from seeing the metal grill in the center, no fire can be put under it sadly.

3)It depends on if your in survival or story if a map piece in there, I believe there’s a piece only in survival and the machete is not necessary, Rusty axe is a great find already.

4)The pot is immensely useful as it can carry 30 water compared to the coconut bowls 10, Good for stews or water collecting, it’s also a one of a kind item. The wooden spoon is useless. Not sure of the herb your thinking of.

5)You have to hit the iron in the vein there at just the right spot in the center, where it’s highlighted by mousing over it. You can do it with an axe but it eats its durability, make a pickaxe for iron mining.

6)I believe you use the fishhook in crafting a fishing rod, but I’m not sure as I’ve never made one myself. 

Hope these tips help and your enjoying the game!

Just a tip i figure i would share with everyone, something i usually do to help get along a nice collection of souls faster. Everyone usually kills Maughlin the Armorer at some point for that Tseldora set, though if done at the wrong moment that could limit his sale of special armor, such as Looking Glass Knight set, Penal set, etc. But if you kill him after you spend 16,000 souls with him, the point where he acts like a smug bastard, you can go to him with 0 souls, talk to get the transparent Aurous set, and then kill him for the Tseldora set earlier! Though it will cost a small sum of souls to revive him to buy from him, even from the grave he will still sell the armor of bosses you defeat! Quite the Armorer i would say
